label: Early copy phase (outputs 2-4) of long sequences, sparse, gated by content
explanation: Fires only in the copy phase, almost entirely at recall_idx 1-3 (74% of mass at recall_idx 2, i.e. step L+2, where the input is orig(1)). The rate rises with L: 55% of mass is in L=9, nearly none at L<=5. It never fires in the original phase, on the delimiter, or at recall_idx 0 or >=4. Within that window it is sparse (about 3-6% of eligible steps), so which content matters is not captured. Upcoming q tokens raise the rate: next_out==q has 11.7x lift, and q at orig(3)/orig(4) gives precision 0.29. Letter inputs n/k/o/a and outputs a/q/w are also enriched. Top activations come from L=8-9 sequences with q in positions 2-4. The positional predicate captures about 95% of mass at about 6% precision. Adding q conditions trades recall for precision (best F1 about 0.29).

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: orig3=q (+4.06), orig4=q (+4.01), orig5=q (+3.70), orig2=q (+3.42), orig6=q (+2.91), phase=2 & in_tok=n (+2.69). Lower it: to_go=1 (-6.56), in_first=1 (-5.91), in_tok=q (-4.58), to_go=0 (-4.45).
